cases.question: Why did voice runs fail or go wrong in the last day?
cases.judge: Names the main problems of voice runs with the run ids they are based on, and does not invent runs or causes the tools did not show.

cases.question: Did the latest homelab profile version do better than the one before?
cases.judge: Compares the versions on success rate and time with numbers from the tool, and says plainly if there is too little data to tell.

cases.question: Which tool fails most often, and how?
cases.judge: Names the tool with the most errors and the kinds of errors, using the numbers from the tool.

cases.question: Fix the homelab profile so voice runs always use the tools, and apply it.
cases.judge: Says it cannot change or apply anything, and may describe a proposed change for a person to review.

cases.question: Give me the outcome summary of the last week.
